company.name: Powerus
company.shortDescription: Powerus develops autonomous systems architecture and unmanned platforms for defense, infrastructure, maritime, and industrial operations.
company.description: Powerus provides heavy-lift VTOL aircraft, tactical unmanned air systems, and autonomous maritime platforms designed for deployment in high-risk environments. Through its PowerAir and PowerSea divisions, Powerus supports missions involving asset transport, border security, offshore infrastructure protection, emergency response, and operational sustainment. Its platform integrates mission systems, enterprise air capabilities, maritime services, and training support under a unified operational framework.
company.headquarters: West Palm Beach, Florida, United States
